name: CRITICAL-two-levels-deep-is-NOT-merged
note: the merge is `{...baseValue, ...overrideValue}` - a SINGLE spread, not a recursive call. retry.provider is therefore REPLACED wholesale and base's retry.provider.timeoutMs is LOST. A recursive implementation would keep it; this is the case that distinguishes shallow from deep.

name: nested-object-only-in-project
note: baseValue is undefined, so the object-merge guard fails and the override object is taken AS IS

name: nested-object-over-scalar
note: typeof baseValue is not object -> else branch -> the override object replaces the scalar

name: scalar-over-nested-object
note: typeof overrideValue is not object -> else branch -> the scalar replaces the object

name: CRITICAL-array-in-both-is-REPLACED
note: both Array.isArray guards exclude arrays from the object-merge branch, so the override array wins WHOLESALE. It is not concatenated, not element-merged, and not deduplicated.
